Name: Cherrim's Valley
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoFrogs.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vHI5F2i.png[/img] 
hello everyone^^ this is my take on giving the outdoor maps a fresh new look and making almost every part of the town overgrown with grass and such for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5407]wildflower grass[/url] mod enjoyers like me :3

this is a kind of map mod that ive been eager to make for years ever since i started making map mods and here we are:3. this mod is heavily inspired by DaisyNiko's legendary Stardew Reimagined series as those mods have become a must have on every one of my playthroughs back then, and has grown to love them, so i wanted to pay homage.

this mod is best played with any flowery grass mods^^

[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoScribbleRed.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JmW5pjh.png[/img]
[list]
[*]lots of big cherry trees everywhere (not sure if they're cherries but they're pink so xDD)[/*]
[*]railroad is now plantable and got a tiny cottage near the train tracks[/*]
[*]new campsite area in the forest[/*]
[*]birds around the valley to interact with[/*]
[*]custom festival maps[/*]
[*]expanded secret woods[/*]
[*]more regrowable stumps and there's also some in the backwoods :D[/*]
[*]even more berry bushes throughout the whole valley[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Banners/Activities/nukoReading.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Xw35Bd.png[/img]
Current expansions I've tested so far that I've provided compatibility patches:
[list]
[*][color=#00ff00]East Scarp[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Ridgeside Village [/color][color=#d8d8d8](though I'd recommend turning off the backwoods edit :3)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Way Back Pelican Town[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Italian Town Buildings[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Little Red Schoolhouse[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Downhill Project[/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Anna Lollipop[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=3]NOT[/size][/b] compatible with: 
[list]
[*][color=#ff0000]SVE [/color][color=#d8d8d8](cherrim's valley is a map replacer hence why it wouldn't work with sve as they would override each other[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Reactions/Embarrassed/nukoEmbarrassedDrop.gif[/img])[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d8d8d8]although I am planning to make an SVE version of cherrim's valley in the future- I'm not promising it to be immediate as I haven't really played with it yet and I'm scared that i might do a massive bug that could explode your device[img]https://nukochannel.neocities.org/NukoImg/Reactions/Embarrassed/nukoEmbarrassed.gif[/img][/color]
